item.content:encoded:
As someone who used to be conscripted into my country's military, the idea of tying in loose ends to fit the high-ups' perception of how things are supposed to be done are stronger in this article.

It's interesting that Nobody is used as an excuse, but it is implied to at least be a thing. Who knows? Maybe it's a memetic entity borne from rumours about it?

P.S. You got yourself an audio adaptation.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This is a story about four people; Somebody, Anybody, Everybody and Nobody

There once was a job that Somebody was supposed to do, and Everybody knew that Anybody could do the job.
However Nobody did the job, which got Everybody mad, since Somebody was supposed to do the job.
Somebody knew he was in trouble and he tried to shift the blame to Anybody, but found Nobody to blame.

… or something like that. Sorry, I'm typing half asleep here.
This article deserves a double upvote.

In a time travel RPG in High School, someone threw a grenade at some unsuspecting Nazi, but it was going to fall short.

One cry of "Yo! Fritz! Catch!" and spectacular roll later, and a local legend was born.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Yeah, I've definitely stuck people with grenades before (and mines, as far back as Goldeneye), and I've definitely pushed people off of roofs before (GTA and others)… it's the combination that I'd like to see. I guess I have to accept the fact that Nobody does it better.

There was a Quake mod that had "sticky" grenades. You'd shoot them and they'd stick to things… and people. Yes, it was just as much fun as it sounds.

"Oh, you just nailed me with FIVE grenades from that launcher? COME HERE AND GIVE ME A HUG!!!"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
O5: Hm. So Nobody came by, took your gun from you, shot the man you were order to take alive thirty-eight times in the chest, stabbed him nine times, then pushed him off the cliff, all before you could do anything about it?

Grunt: Yeah! Bastard stole my wallet, too.

Wow. I've been looking for stuff about nobody ever since I read about him in the GIS, and this is fantastic.
Maybe Nobody doesn't actually exist, and is just the scapegoat for anything that goes wrong in the field. Whatever he/she/it is, this is the kind of stuff that I want to see more of.

If I could up vote more than once, I would.
